changes: Added relation p1 grandson_of p3, which follows from the father–son chain Ḍhuṇḍhirāja → Bālakṛṣṇa → Śaṅkara.

Made p1's affiliation more precise: Mahārāṣṭra family, old surname Morvaṇīkara and later surname Bāndhavakara (written 'vāṃdhavakara'). The surname epithets describe the family line, so they are recorded as a family affiliation.
Expanded the notes: the author is identified, the copy has no date, and the corrupt readings are explained.

persons.name: Śaṅkara
persons.affiliation: Mahārāṣṭra family; surnames Morvaṇīkara (ancestral) and Bāndhavakara (later)

notes: This is only the author's colophon, at the end of the 7th ucchvāsa ('ucchāsaḥ' in the manuscript) of the Gaṅgāvataraṇacampū by Śaṅkara Dīkṣita. Śaṅkara was the son of Bālakṛṣṇa Dīkṣita and grandson of Ḍhuṇḍhirāja Dīkṣita, from a Mahārāṣṭrian family (18th century). No scribe, owner, date or place of copying is given. Corrupt readings: 'ṭhuḍhirā' stands for Ḍhuṇḍhirāja, 'dīkṣia' for dīkṣita, 'tanamorvaṇīkara' for ciraṃtana-Morvaṇīkara, and 'vāṃdhavakara' for Bāndhavakara. 'gaṃgācaraṃākaḥ' is probably a corruption of the chapter title and is uncertain.
